header.title: SSSS September Newsletter
header.description: yooooo, what's going on SOSY students?! Let's start the last semester of 2026 off right with a recap of August - September!

text: Learn how to get the most out of your CS/SoSy degree at Roadmap Night! This event gives you direct access to SFU faculty perspective and peer experience, helping you take a more goal-driven approach to your degree.
It's By-Election time for the SSSS Executive Team! If you are interested, send your nomination to ss-pres@sfu.ca BEFORE SEPTEMBER 28 @ 11:59PM with the following info:
- A blurb/speech on why you should be chosen
Info about the roles can be found in the link provided.
Congratulations to all the SOSY Froshees on their first-ever FROSH! Shout-out to all the SOSY execs/leaders who helped out with the week's events <3
Pizza, Board Games, and SOSY friends! What more could you need?
SOSY hit their step count and caught some nice views during their Hiking SSSSocial!
Play some board games and take a break from studying!
SSSStudy with your peers! Prep for midterms, assignments, and projects.
